ASYMMETRIC with create: Edit does NOT call REST PUT /api/global-options/{id}. Instead it fires a client-constructed Hasura GraphQL table-level mutation 'updateGlobalOption' -> update_global_options_by_pk(pk_columns, _set:{data,name,global_option_category_id,updated_at}) directly against POST /api/graphql. The client builds the _set object itself, structurally similar to the insert_cliparts pattern already flagged in asset-category FEAT-03 as a client-constructed Hasura mutation risk area. No negative/cross-tenant sample was taken this run.

REST POST /api/global-options/{id}/clone (no request body), 201, deep-copies 'data' JSON verbatim, auto-names '<original name> (copy)' — note the exact format uses parentheses+space, DIFFERENT from asset-category's clone naming convention ('<name> copy', no parens) documented in asset-category FEAT-02.
REST DELETE /api/global-options/{id}, 204. Native confirm dialog verbatim text: 'Are you sure to remove <name>?' with buttons 'Remove' / 'Cancel'.

observations.element: 2 text-type layers, both personalization='Use an existing global option' -> same Global Option instance (id 860)
observations.observed_result: Follow-up business-rule verification requested by peer agent aa341cc5a8119ce04 on behalf of the product owner's claim (2026-09-15, same-artwork version of a cross-artwork sharing rule): 'editing one field's value should live-update all other fields referencing that same Global Option, within a single artwork'. Built 2 text layers on a throwaway artwork, both referencing Global Option id=860 (type=text). Edited layer A's text value in-editor (double-click -> inline input -> 'SHARED VALUE TEST' -> Enter): (1) IMMEDIATELY -- zero network requests fired at all on this edit, and layer B's rendered text remained 'Default text' (confirmed via isolating each layer's visibility and screenshotting separately). (2) AFTER EXPLICIT SAVE -- server response for POST /api/artworks (id 4171) persisted layer-244343.text='Default text' and layer-357596.text='SHARED VALUE TEST' as independent per-layer values, both under global_option=860. CONCLUSION: observed behavior contradicts the stated business rule -- no live update, and no update after save/reload either, for this specific mechanism (in-portal editor default/preview text value). Reported as a plain factual conflict, not resolved by portal-explorer.

observations.element: new text layer added to artwork 4167; campaign list Status column; campaign editor PERSONALIZATION FORM; GO#862 Prompt field (read-only)
observations.observed_result: Peer-requested follow-up (agent aa341cc5a8119ce04): added a 2nd layer (text, id=layer-558994) to EXISTING artwork #4167, personalization='Use an existing global option'->GO#860, without touching the existing text-to-image/GO#862 layer (layer-885184, confirmed unchanged in the same PUT response). THREE additional findings surfaced while completing this: (1) campaign #2605's top-right button was already 'Update' from the prior task and remained so after this edit -- not newly triggered, not clicked. (2) MAJOR CORRECTION: the /campaigns list page shows campaign #2605 Status as 'Published on current store' (timestamp = its original creation time, not a later event), with an 'Update required 1' filter tab -- this contradicts this agent's own earlier repeated claim that the campaign was 'draft/Unpublished' (based only on the internal status=0 field, which evidently does not mean 'not on the platform'). Two other pre-existing campaigns in this store also show 'Published on current store', suggesting this may be automatic/default for any campaign with a real product+variants, not gated by a manual Launch/Update click. Live storefront tabs already open elsewhere in this session point to a real, reachable product page for this exact campaign, corroborating a real Shopify product already exists. (3) The campaign editor's own generated PERSONALIZATION FORM shows exactly ONE input for GO#860 ('Enter your full name (edited)') even though 2 different layers in 2 different artworks (4167 and 4172) both reference global_option=860 -- suggesting the customer-facing form deduplicates by Global Option id rather than rendering one field per layer, a structurally different mechanism from the same-artwork in-portal-editor default-text test (OBS-019). Additionally, as a convenience read (no edit made, Cancel/no-save): Global Option #862's Prompt field currently reads 'Generate baby image', confirmed different from the value captured in ACT-01-02-001 ('A colorful abstract pattern of {{name}}') -- consistent with the peer's note that the user manually edited it outside any agent session; the old captured value is now stale/historical only.

cross_object_notes.topic: 'Use an existing global option' picker is filtered by matching Global Option 'type'
cross_object_notes.observation: With 7 Global Option instances existing across all 7 groups (text, text-to-image, additional-option, vector-category, maps, word-search, qr-code) at the time, the 'Select a global option*' picker on a text-to-image layer showed ONLY the 1 text-to-image instance (QA-GO-IMG-TextToImage-01). The other 6 were not listed at all.
cross_object_notes.action_requested: Useful for artwork checklist: any test case exercising 'Use an existing global option' should account for this type-filtering — a mismatched-type Global Option will simply not appear as selectable, not show an error.

cross_object_notes.topic: 'Static Image'/'Static Vector' availability differs between the Global-Option create modal and the artwork layer-add modal
cross_object_notes.observation: Same-looking 'Select a layer type' 7-group/29-button modal component is used both when creating a Global Option and when adding a layer to an artwork. In the Global-Option context, 'Static Image' and 'Static Vector' are disabled ('(Unavailable)'). In the artwork-layer context, both are enabled.
cross_object_notes.action_requested: Informational only — likely intentional (a Global Option is meant to be reusable/parametrized, so a 'static' fixed image/vector that can't vary per-artwork may not make sense as a reusable option type). Not concluded, just flagged for anyone building a full layer-type matrix across objects.

cross_object_notes.topic: Product-owner business rule claim ('same-Global-Option fields live-update together within one artwork') does NOT match observed behavior
cross_object_notes.observation: See OBS-019 / FEAT-08 / ACT-08-01-001 for full evidence. Two text layers on one artwork, both personalization='Use an existing global option' pointed at the identical Global Option instance (id 860), retain fully independent 'text' (default/preview) values -- no live update on edit (zero network calls fired), and no sync after an explicit Save (server-persisted JSON shows both layers' text values independently, under the same global_option=860).
cross_object_notes.action_requested: CONFLICT between a stated business-rule claim and observed current behavior -- do not treat either side as correct. This is one data point using the in-portal editor default/preview text value only; it does NOT test whether a real customer-entered value at storefront personalization time behaves differently (separate surface, storefront-explorer territory). Orchestrator/reviewer to route: either the claimed rule is wrong/not-yet-implemented, or the mechanism for sharing lives somewhere this check did not exercise (e.g. only at storefront customization time, or only for a specific layer type/config not covered by these 2 plain text layers).
